_comment: Copy to appsettings.Development.json (gitignored) to run the service with `dotnet run` against
a MySQL started by Docker. The values below match docker-compose.yml, so `docker compose up
processing-db` followed by `dotnet run` works with no further editing.
These are local development credentials. They are the same values docker-compose.yml defaults
to, are never used in staging or production, and must not be reused anywhere real.
